cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: I Started the Weirdness
cards.instruction: Hide that one casual choice caused the impossible situation while eagerly helping manage each new consequence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The cups are floating. I'll tie them down while you rescue breakfast.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You flicked that gravity switch reaching for the toaster.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could've been the toaster. Give me the string; I'll secure everything.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Now I'm floating. Hold my ankles.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've got you. I'll tie you to the radiator. Tell the others the toaster needs fixing.

reason: State B actual floating before ankle rescue rather than rely on imagined position on a rising table; turn account control into a directed false-appliance message while A performs rescue.
